items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No. Nunez. New Knicks. They place there now.

ctx.x: No. He wasn't no cousin of Bunk. They were over on that side of the river then all the time. That's where they, really, right there on, uh, on, uh. Tash Street. No. Nunez.
New Knicks. They place there now. The younger ones, the younger ones, they had ads in that place because they can't sell it. It's there now. They where the Yankee Buddy comes from.
